title: Show HN: An e-ink frame that hears birds and draws them as 1800s illustrations
summary: A Show HN project presents an e-ink picture frame that listens for bird calls, identifies the species, and generates 1800s-style illustrations of the detected birds. The system combines audio recognition with generative image models to produce a real-time, ambient display. Discussion references a related 'Avian Visitors' project from May 2026.
